'''April 2001 Mount Laurel tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mt. Laurel, NJ on 8 April 2001. Ghetto Leader (DeckTech handle; first name Greg) won it. It is known from Pete Flamini's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2047">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-09-mt-laurel-nj-04-08-01d2047/ mt-laurel-nj-04-08-01], DeckTech (Pete "Ghetto 13" Flamini, 9 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-09-mt-laurel-nj-04-08-01d2047/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Mt. Laurel, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' Ghetto Leader (DeckTech handle; first name Greg)
